paragraphs: 5 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Tuesday for 5 clubs across 4 levels, with Drew Thorpe producing the night's most notable performance.
Drew Thorpe started on the mound for Charlotte Knights.
Drew Thorpe worked 5.0 innings, allowing 1 hit and 0 earned runs, with 1 walk and 4 strikeouts.
One of his strikeouts came in the second on a 2-2 86 mph slider, when he put away Lenyn Sosa.

Ryan Stafford went 0-for-3, 1 RBI, 1 run scored, 1 walk for Frederick Keys at High-A. Ryan Stafford drove in his lone run with a forceout in the eighth toward shortstop on a 1-0 pitch from Adolfo Oviedo. He batted ninth and started behind the plate. Frederick Keys beat Greensboro Grasshoppers, 13-1.
Zach Daudet went 1-for-3, 1 run scored, 1 walk for Corpus Christi Hooks at Double-A. He batted ninth and started at third base. Corpus Christi Hooks beat Midland RockHounds, 6-4.

Brooks Lee went 1-for-4, 1 double, 1 run scored for Minnesota Twins. Brooks Lee produced a double in the first to right field on a 0-2 80 mph curveball from Drew Anderson. He batted second and started at third base. Minnesota Twins beat Detroit Tigers, 3-2.

Steven Brooks came on in relief for Portland Sea Dogs in the top of the ninth with nobody out. He worked 1.0 innings, allowing 1 hit and 0 earned runs, striking out 1 without issuing a walk. One of his strikeouts came in the ninth on a 1-2 pitch, when he put away JT Benson. Portland Sea Dogs beat Binghamton Rumble Ponies, 8-6.
Away from the box scores, there was also roster movement involving former Mustangs.
Zach Daudet was called up on Tuesday, moving from the High-A Asheville Tourists to the Double-A Corpus Christi Hooks.
title: Drew Thorpe highlights a busy Tuesday for former Mustangs
